## Is Your Feature Request Related to a Problem?
A clear description of the problem or gap. e.g. "I can never tell whether a pitcher's ERA is driven by luck or skill..."

## Describe the Solution You'd Like
What would you like to see added or changed? Be as specific as possible — which tab of the briefing, which metric, what the output should look like.

## Describe Alternatives You've Considered
Any other approaches or workarounds you've tried.

## Additional Context
Links to relevant baseball analytics references, data sources, or examples from other tools are very welcome.
